
{{alias}}( arr )
    Converts an array of ndarray-like objects to an array of objects likely to
    have the same "shape".

    Each returned object has the following properties:

    - ref: reference to the original ndarray-like object.
    - dtype: underlying data type.
    - data: data buffer.
    - length: number of elements.
    - shape: array dimensions.
    - strides: array strides.
    - offset: index offset.
    - order: order.
    - accessorProtocol: boolean indicating whether the data buffer uses
    accessors for getting and setting elements.
    - accessors: a two-element array whose first element is an accessor for
    retrieving an ndarray element and whose second element is an accessor for
    setting an ndarray element.

    The getter accessor accepts two arguments:

    - data: data buffer.
    - idx: element index.

    The setter accessor accepts three arguments:

    - data: data buffer.
    - idx: element index.
    - value: value to set.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arr: ArrayLike<ndarray>
        List of input ndarrays.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Array<Object>
        List of objects containing ndarray meta data.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/array}}( [ [ 1, 2 ], [ 3, 4 ] ] );
    > var out = {{alias}}( [ x ] )
    [ {...} ]

    See Also
    --------
